title: The Floating Island
overview: Fran and Teacher join forces with a benevolent necromancer to conquer a dungeon on a floating island.

title: Jean du Vix Knows His Stuff
overview: Jean's expertise proves invaluable as the dungeon's dangers and dark history reveal themselves.

title: The Undead Monster Was Tough as Nails
overview: The dungeon guardian proves itself a fearsome opponent.

title: The Hopeless Battle Against the Undead King
overview: It will take more than brute strength to defeat the Lich.

title: A Smiling Farewell
overview: Teacher must unleash his full potential to pull Fran back from the verge of death.
